object.name: Device.Thread.BorderRouter.{i}.
object.description:
The BorderRouter is capable of forwarding between a Thread Network and a non-Thread Network. Each BorderRouter entry is associated with a particular Thread Network (or MLE) instance via the {{param|MLEReference}} parameter.
Note: the BorderAgentID unique key was deprecated in favor of {{param|BorderAgentReference}} since 2.22 with the introduction of {{object|#.BorderAgent}} representing the Border Agent capabilities.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: Enables or disables this border router.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the status of this border router.

parameter.name: BorderAgentID
BorderAgentReference
parameter.description: Reference to the {{object|#.BorderAgent}} entry representing the Border Agent function associated with this Border Router.

parameter.name: MLEReference
parameter.description: Define the Thread network to which it belongs.

parameter.name: RoutingRef
parameter.description: Define the routing and forwarding configuration of the BorderRouter, in order to access the Thread Network it manages. This is the way to manage ::/64 prefix used for global addressing of the mesh network (see Thread Specification {{bibref|ThreadIPv6Addressing}} "IPv6 Address Configuration").

object.name: Device.Thread.BorderAgent.{i}.
object.description:
A Border Agent is a Thread device relaying Mesh Commissioning Protocol (MeshCoP) messages between a Thread Network and a Commissioner. The Commissioner may be reachable via either a non-Thread Network (External Commissioner) or a Thread Network (Native Commissioner). The Border Agent requires a Thread Interface to operate and may coexist with any other Thread role except the Joiner.
Each entry in this table represents a Thread Border Agent service and its Thread Administration Sharing (TAS) capability.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: Enables or disables the Border Agent service on the device.

parameter.name: ID
parameter.description: The globally unique {{param}} generated by the Thread Border Agent that uniquely identifies the device.

parameter.name: State

enumeration.description: The service is enabled but not yet active
The service is enabled and active, external Commissioner can connect using PSKc
The service is enabled but activation failed

parameter.name: SessionNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

object.name: Device.Thread.BorderAgent.{i}.Session.{i}.
object.description: Represents current Border Agent sessions used to commission a Thread Device onto the Thread Network using MeshCoP (Mesh Commissioning Protocol). Each entry in the table represents a session as reported by the Border Agent service. The session advertised through the _meshcop-e._udp service for the Thread Administration Sharing (TAS) is not considered here.

parameter.name: Address
parameter.description: Peer IPv6 address for the session.

parameter.name: Port
parameter.description: UDP port of the _meshcop._udp service.

parameter.name: Connected
parameter.description: {{param}} is {{true}} if the Border Agent session is currently connected.

parameter.name: IsCommissioner
parameter.description: {{param}} is {{true}} if the Border Agent session is accepted as the full Commissioner.

parameter.name: Lifetime
parameter.description: Session lifetime in {{units}} since the session was established.

object.name: Device.Thread.BorderAgent.{i}.TAS.
object.description: Controls and monitors Thread Administration Sharing (TAS) session using ephemeral PSKc (ePSKc): start/stop window, state/port reporting, and {{param|PasscodeURI}} for user interactions.

parameter.name: State
parameter.description: The TAS state of the Border Agent's Ephemeral Key Manager.

enumeration.description: The manager is available but not active
A DTLS session using ePSKc has been established

parameter.name: DefaultPort
parameter.description: Default UDP port of the _meshcop-e._udp service when TAS is active (distinct from _meshcop._udp port).

parameter.name: DefaultTimeout
parameter.description: Default TAS window duration in {{units}}.

parameter.name: DefaultMaxFailedAttempts
parameter.description: Maximum allowed failed DTLS connection attempts in a TAS window before automatic deactivation.

parameter.name: PasscodeLength
parameter.description: Length of the Thread Administrator Passcode (ePSKc).

parameter.name: PasscodeURI
parameter.description: URN {{bibref|RFC8141}} carrying the passcode digits: "urn:thread:pc:\<digits\>". Non-empty only while {{param|State}} is {{enum|Started|State}}. {{param}} is cleared when {{param|State}} transitions to {{enum|Connected|State}} or {{enum|Stopped|State}} or {{enum|Disabled|State}}.

object.name: Device.Thread.Radio.{i}.
object.description: This object models an 802.15.4 wireless radio ({{bibref|802.15.4-2020}}) on the device (a stackable interface object as described in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2}}).

parameter.name: TransmitPowerSupported
parameter.description: {{list}} List items represent supported transmit power levels as {{units}} of full power. For example, "0,25,50,75,100". A -1 item indicates auto mode (automatic decision by device). Auto mode allows the {{object}} to adjust transmit power accordingly. For example, this can be useful for power-save modes such as EU-CoC, where the {{object}} can adjust power according to activity in the device.

parameter.name: TransmitPower
parameter.description: Indicates the current transmit power level as a {{units}} of full power. The value MUST be one of the values reported by the {{param|TransmitPowerSupported}} parameter. A value of -1 indicates auto mode (automatic decision by device).

parameter.name: HardwareVersion
parameter.description: This radio's Thread hardware version.

parameter.name: FirmwareVersion
parameter.description: This radio's Thread firmware version.

object.name: Device.Thread.MLE.{i}.
object.description: This object models the Mesh Link Establishment (MLE) (a stackable interface object as described in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2}}) used to establish and configure secure radio link of Thread network.

parameter.name: SupportedStandards
parameter.description: The items in the list indicate the supported Thread version. The associated border router can only support one standard at a time.

parameter.name: OperatingStandard
parameter.description: The operating standard this {{object}} instance is configured for.

parameter.name: DataVersion

parameter.name: LeaderRouterID
parameter.description: The 8-bit {{param}} the Node attempts to utilize upon becoming a router or leader on the Thread network.

parameter.name: PartitionID
parameter.description: The Thread Leader Partition ID for the Thread network to which the Node is joined.

parameter.name: StableDataVersion

parameter.name: Weighting

object.name: Device.Thread.MLE.{i}.Dataset.{i}.
object.description:
Thread network configuration parameters are managed using an active and one optional pending Operational Dataset objects.
The active Operational Dataset includes parameters (defined in the Thread specification, see {{bibref|ThreadSpec}}) that are currently in use across an entire Thread network. The active Operational Dataset contains: * Timestamp * Channel * Channel Mask * Extended PAN ID * Mesh-Local Prefix * Network Name * PAN ID * PSKc * Network key * Security Policy
The pending Operational Dataset is used to communicate changes to the active Operational Dataset before they take effect. The pending Operational Dataset contains all the parameters from the Active Operational Dataset, with the addition of: Delay Timer.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the status of this dataset.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: {{param}} of the dataset, depending status, it represent : * Active Timestamp (timestamp of the current dataset) * Pending Timestamp

parameter.name: DelayTimer
parameter.description: An unsigned 32-bit number in milliseconds indicate the Time Remaining when pending Dataset will be activated. This value MUST be 0 for active dataset.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: The IEEE 802.15.4 channel value of the interface defined in {{bibref|ThreadSpec}} (Thread specification only supports the 2450 MHz channels).

parameter.name: NetworkName
parameter.description: The name of the network link to the interface.

parameter.name: PanID
parameter.description: The IEEE 802.15.4 PAN ID value link to the interface.

parameter.name: ExtendedPanID
parameter.description: The IEEE 802.15.4 ExtPAN ID value link to the interface.

parameter.name: MeshLocalPrefix
parameter.description: Indicate the mesh-local IPv6 prefix for the Thread network.

parameter.name: ChannelMask
parameter.description: Indicates the channels within channel page 0, in the 2.4GHz ISM band. The channels are represented in most significant bit order, with bit value 1 meaning selected, bit value 0 meaning unselected.

parameter.name: PSKc
parameter.description: Pre-Shared Key Credential for inband commissioning.

parameter.name: NetworkKey
parameter.description: Key of the network.

object.description: Entries in this table reference nodes that are immediate neighbors of the associated node instance. This table is empty if the {{param|#.RoutingRole}} is not a {{enum|Router|#.RoutingRole}} or {{enum|Leader|#.RoutingRole}}.

parameter.name: NodeReference

parameter.name: AvgRSSI
parameter.description: The average Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) is the average measurement of the signal strength received by the parent router node from the neighbor node.

object.name: Device.Thread.MLE.{i}.AssociatedNode.{i}.Route.{i}.
object.description: Entries in this table depend on the associated node routing capabilities defined by the {{param|#.RoutingRole}} and {{param|#.Mode}} according to the Thread Specification (i.e. a child node has an empty {{object}} table). It maintains information for each link to Router neighbor as follows: * the Router ID assigned to that neighbor. * the routing cost. * the incoming link quality metric calculated from the measured link margin for messages received from the neighbor. * the incoming link quality metric reported by the neighbor for messages arriving from this Router.

parameter.name: ID

parameter.name: PathCost

parameter.name: LQIn

parameter.name: LQOut

command.name: Start()
command.description: Starts a TAS/ePSKc window: 1. generates a Thread Administrator Passcode (digits with Verhoeff check digit) 1. derives ePSKc (ASCII of digits) 1. advertises _meshcop-e._udp 1. sets {{param|#.State}} = {{enum|Started|#.State}} 1. updates {{param|#.PasscodeURI}} while {{enum|Started|#.State}}.

parameter.name: SessionTimeout
parameter.description: The TAS window duration in {{units}}. If {{param}} is not defined, {{param|#.DefaultTimeout}} is used as default.

parameter.name: SessionPort
parameter.description: UDP port of the _meshcop-e._udp service. If {{param}} is not defined, {{param|#.DefaultPort}} is used as default.

parameter.name: SessionMaxFailedAttempts
parameter.description: Maximum allowed failed DTLS connection attempts in a TAS window before automatic deactivation. If {{param}} is not defined, {{param|#.DefaultMaxFailedAttempts}} is used as default.

parameter.name: EphemeralPSKc
parameter.description: The one-time generated Thread Administrator Passcode (ePSKc). {{param}} a sequence of cryptographic random numeric digits (0-9) of length {{param|#.PasscodeLength}}-1, to which the Verhoeff check digit is added as the last digit.

command.name: SetActiveDataset()
command.description:
Create, or replace existing, {{object|Dataset}} instance.
When this command is call : * if the {{object|Device.Thread.MLE.{i}.}} instance is enabled and {{param|Status}} is Up then all nodes attached to the interface receive the order to change their Dataset, * else the active Dataset is stored and will be activated when the {{object|Device.Thread.MLE.{i}.}} instance becomes enabled and Up.

parameter.name: TLVs
parameter.description:
The TLV encodings for the active {{object|Dataset}} parameters that will be used across an entire Thread network. The active Operational Dataset TLVs encode : * Active Timestamp * Channel * Channel Mask * Extended PAN ID * Mesh-Local Prefix * Network Name * PAN ID * PSKc * Security Policy
The encoding in {{param}} for the active Dataset field is defined in the Thread specification (see {{bibref|ThreadSpec}}).

command.name: SetPendingDataset()
command.description: Create, or replace existing, pending {{object|Dataset}} instance with parameters provided in the TLVs.

parameter.name: TLVs
parameter.description:
The TLV encodings for the pending Dataset parameters that will be use across an entire Thread network. The pending Operational Dataset TLVs encode : * Pending Timestamp * Channel * Channel Mask * Extended PAN ID * Mesh-Local Prefix * Network Name * PAN ID * PSKc * Security Policy
The encoding in {{param}} for the pending Dataset field is defined in the Thread specification (see {{bibref|ThreadSpec}}).

command.name: GetActiveDataset()
command.description: Get the TLVs of the active {{object|Dataset}} ({{param|Dataset.{i}.Status}} is active).

parameter.name: TLVs
parameter.description:

The encoding in {{param}} for the active Dataset field is defined in the Thread specification (see {{bibref|ThreadSpec}}).

command.name: GetPendingDataset()

parameter.name: TLVs
parameter.description:
The TLV encodings the pending Dataset parameters that will be use across an entire Thread network. The pending Operational Dataset TLVs encode : * Pending Timestamp * Channel * Channel Mask * Delay Timer * Extended PAN ID * Mesh-Local Prefix * Network Name * PAN ID * PSKc * Security Policy
The encoding in {{param}} for the pending Dataset field is defined in the Thread specification (see {{bibref|ThreadSpec}}).

command.name: NetworkDiagnostic()
command.description:
The {{command}} command provides a mechanism to obtain connectivity, topology, and link quality data from all the Thread devices in a Thread network (see {{bibref|ThreadSpec|Section Diagnostic Commands}}).
On invocation, the agent sends a Thread Get Diagnostic Request to {{param|TargetIPv6Address}} (unicast or multicast address). This command requests the TLVs defined in the {{param|RequestedTLVTypes}} list. For unicast, the command completes on first response or timeout ({{param|RequestTimeout}}); for multicast, the agent aggregates all responses received before the {{param|RequestTimeout}} expires, then returns the set.

parameter.name: TargetIPv6Address
RequestedTLVTypes
parameter.description:
List of requested TLV IDs as defined in {{bibref|ThreadSpec|Table Diagnostic TLVs}}.
Examples of TLV IDs extracted from {{bibref|ThreadSpec}}, the number of defined TLV IDs in the Thread specification can increase in future releases: * 0x00 ExtMacAddress (Extended MAC Address (EUI‑64) of the radio interface) * 0x01 Address16 (Node’s 16‑bit RLOC address) * 0x02 Mode (Device mode flags (RX‑on‑when‑idle, FTD/MTD, FullNetData…)) * 0x03 Timeout (MLE timeout, notably for children) * 0x04 Connectivity (Connectivity indicators: parent priority, link qualities, cost to Leader…) * 0x05 Route64 (Routing information, router table, in Route64 format) * 0x06 LeaderData (Partition/leader data (PartitionId, Weighting, DataVersion…)) * 0x07 NetworkData (Full Network Data) * 0x08 IPv6AddressList (Node’s IPv6 address list) * 0x09 MacCounters (MAC counters (Tx/Rx, Retries, CCA failure, FCS error…)) * 0x0E BatteryLevel (Battery level if exposed) * 0x0F SupplyVoltage (Supply voltage if exposed) * 0x10 ChildTable (Child table (if Node acts as parent/router)) * 0x11 ChannelPages (Supported channel pages) * 0x12 TypeList (List of supported Network Diagnostics TLV types) * 0x13 MaxChildTimeout (Maximum child timeout (Thread 1.2+)) * 0x18 Version (Node’s Thread version)

parameter.name: RequestTimeout
parameter.description: Overall time in {{units}} to wait for responses.

object.name: Node.{i}.
object.description: One entry for each respondent Nodes to the {{command}} request.

parameter.name: SourceAddress
parameter.description: Source IPv6 address observed for the response (Mesh‑Local or Link‑Local), as received by the initiator.

object.name: Node.{i}.TLV.{i}.
object.description: One entry per TLV returned by the Node.

parameter.name: TLVType
parameter.description: TLV ID in hexadecimal, as defined in {{bibref|ThreadSpec}} (also see examples from {{param|RequestedTLVTypes}}).

parameter.name: RawValue
parameter.description: Raw TLV value encoded in base64 (the Value field only; Type and Length excluded).
